items.reason: The new removal path calls `group.users.delete(user_id)` at app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90, bypassing the destruction callback for the custom `user_count` counter in app/models/group_user.rb:2. The associations at app/models/group.rb:5-8 do not configure that custom counter, so [Rails 4.1.8's association counter handling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rails/rails/v4.1.8/activerecord/lib/active_record/associations/has_many_association.rb) does not decrement it. This leaves the count serialized at app/serializers/basic_group_serializer.rb:2 inflated, although member pagination independently obtains the actual count at app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:25.
